meta.title: Sealed Files
meta.description: End-to-end encrypted files and notes between the people signed in to DSH and the assistant: encrypted in the browser, streamed with seeking, previewed in place.

ui.title: Sealed Files
ui.empty: Nothing here yet. Press New, or drop files on this page.
ui.preview.none: No preview for this kind of file. Save it to open it.
ui.upload.resume: Unfinished: {name}. Pick the same file again to continue.
ui.note.title: Title (optional)
ui.note.name: Note {when}
ui.folder.name: Folder name
ui.name: Name
ui.enroll.title: Add this device
ui.enroll.text: Everything here is encrypted on your own devices before it leaves them. This browser makes a key of its own; you add it once by comparing a code.
ui.enroll.name: Name for this device
ui.enroll.wait: {assistant} sends you the same code in a chat message. If the two match, reply there that they do. You can also approve this device from one you added before.
ui.enroll.homeScreen: On iPhone or iPad, use DSH from your Home Screen. Safari clears a website's keys after a week without a visit; the Home Screen app keeps them.
ui.notMapped: This sign-in isn't linked to anyone here, so there are no files to show.
ui.noCrypto: This browser can't do the encryption this page needs (it needs X25519 in Web Crypto: Safari 17, Chrome 133, Firefox 130 or newer).
ui.noWorker: This browser didn't start the page's service worker, which decrypts files. Reload the page; in a private window it may not work.
ui.keyChanged.title: The assistant's key has changed
ui.keyChanged.text: When this device was added it saved a different key for the assistant. Someone may be in the middle. Don't use this device until you've checked with your assistant. To start over, remove this device here and add it again.
ui.keyChanged.reset: Remove this device and start over
ui.devices.confirmRemove: Remove “{name}”? It can be added again with a new code.
ui.devices.approveCheck: Approve “{name}”? Only if it shows code {code}.
ui.error.file-too-large: That file is larger than the limit ({max}).
ui.error.store-full: There's no room left here. Delete something first.
ui.error.disk-full: The disk is nearly full. Delete something first.
